profile.name: Thuan | KayStar
profile.title: Software Engineer | Enterprise Platforms | System Architecture

summary: Software Engineer with 3+ years of professional experience designing and delivering enterprise platforms, ERP, e-commerce and social applications. I design composable React frontends, owned .NET services and reliable asynchronous processing with an emphasis on explicit boundaries, reusable foundations and long-term maintainability. I am also pursuing a Master's degree in Applied Information Technology at HUIT.

experiences.title: Software Engineer
details: Design and build a modular enterprise platform around maintainable frontend, backend and distributed-processing boundaries.
Design the React frontend with Micro Frontend and Feature-Sliced Design, separating host, module, feature and shared-layer ownership.
Build metadata-driven routing, navigation, permissions and module registration with generated contracts to reduce configuration drift.
Structure .NET Microservices with Clean Architecture, DDD and CQRS across explicit Domain, Application, Infrastructure and API boundaries.
Standardize API Gateway, shared contracts, typed service clients and shared-kernel foundations to protect service ownership and prevent cross-service data access.
Build RabbitMQ workers for automation, document processing and notifications with idempotency, bounded concurrency and graceful shutdown; support SQL Server multi-tenancy and CI/CD quality gates.

experiences.title: Full-Stack Developer
details: Delivered enterprise business systems across backend services, frontend applications, data storage and release workflows.
Applied Clean Architecture, domain modeling, CQRS and microservices thinking to structure complex business products.
Worked with .NET, React, SQL Server and Azure DevOps across product development workflows.
Integrated Power BI, OpenAI and SQL Server stored procedures for internal business systems.
Built reusable components and refactored shared backend/frontend foundations for maintainability.

experiences.title: Full-Stack Developer
details: Delivered e-commerce, ERP and social network software across database, API and web admin layers.
Built reusable menu packages, base components and internal code-generation tooling.
Worked with maintainability-focused enterprise software domains where business clarity and extensibility mattered.
Guided new team members, reviewed code and collaborated through Agile/Scrum workflows.
